profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Microsoft | Computer Engineering
profile.summary: With over a decade of professional experience, my role as a Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft has been marked by a deep engagement a heaping list of ever-expanding technologies, including Azure, .NET Framework, Python, OpenAI, and even Javascript. Previously, I applied these competencies at S&P Capital IQ and S&P Global Market Intelligence, where I contributed to significant projects that advanced our technical capabilities, not limited to real-time ticker information via PubSub implementation. My mission is to continuously deliver robust and innovative software solutions that align with Microsoft's visionary culture, and I'm committed to bringing diverse perspectives to our collaborative team to achieve collective success.
